title: Driving on Registers, Reasoning on Risk: Risk-Aware Occupancy for Register-Based End-to-End Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2609.21486v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal trajectory prediction improves behavioral coverage in end-to-end autonomous driving, but existing methods remain limited by sparse scene representations. Incomplete evidence leads to low-quality candidate generation and unreliable ranking among geometrically similar trajectories. On a register-based baseline, bad and poor candidates constitute 19.74% of the candidate set, while the oracle-best candidate ranks only 33.9th on average. We propose RRDrive, which introduces risk-aware occupancy as a dense, temporally aligned, and trajectory-queryable representation. Its global structure guides high-quality multimodal generation, while candidate-conditioned risk queries support fine-grained selection. We further construct RiskOcc4D-NAVSIM with automatic risk annotations. translated_title: 基于寄存器的驾驶，基于风险的推理：面向基于寄存器的端到端自动驾驶的风险感知占用表示
translated_abstract: 多模态轨迹预测提升了端到端自动驾驶中的行为覆盖范围，但现有方法仍受限于稀疏的场景表示。不完整的证据会导致低质量的候选生成，以及几何相似轨迹之间不可靠的排序。在一个基于寄存器的基线上，差和较差的候选占候选集的19.74%，而最优候选平均仅排在第33.9位。我们提出RRDrive，引入风险感知占用作为一种稠密的、时间对齐的、可按轨迹查询的表示。其全局结构引导高质量的多模态生成，而以候选为条件的风险查询支持细粒度的选择。我们进一步构建了带有自动风险标注的RiskOcc4D-NAVSIM数据集。RRDrive实现了0.951的所选轨迹PDMS，相比基线（0.937）相对提升1.5%，并将平均候选PDMS提升了……
tldr: 提出RRDrive，通过引入稠密、时间对齐且可按轨迹查询的风险感知占用表示，引导高质量多模态轨迹生成并进行细粒度的候选风险选择，在NAVSIM上将所选轨迹PDMS提升至0.951（相对基线提升1.5%）。
en_tdlr: RRDrive introduces risk-aware occupancy as a dense, temporally aligned, and trajectory-queryable representation to guide high-quality multimodal trajectory generation and fine-grained candidate selection, improving selected-trajectory PDMS to 0.951 (a 1.5% relative gain over the baseline).
